name: chronicle
summary: A zombie paglet that keeps a life log of the mesh on every host and delivers it once

messages.name: start
messages.summary: Starts the replica group; the log goes to the sink when the lifetime ends

messages.name: status
messages.summary: Role, replicas, main and progress of this replica

messages.name: finish
messages.summary: Ends the work early: the main delivers the log

fields.name: sink
fields.doc: Where the log goes: host:NAME (that host's zombies paglet)

fields.name: suspect_ms
fields.doc: Silence after which the main is suspected (0: default)

fields.name: expand_ms
fields.doc: How often the main looks for hosts without a replica (0: default)
